github_readme:
## Karan Singh - Restaurant Operations Leader

Welcome to my professional repository. I am an experienced Restaurant Manager with over 12 years in hospitality operations, specializing in front-of-house management, team leadership, inventory control, and customer service excellence. This repository showcases my approach to operational coordination, staff scheduling, and service improvement initiatives.

### Core Competencies
- Restaurant Operations Management
- Staff Supervision & Team Leadership
- Inventory Control & Scheduling
- Customer Service & Escalation Handling
- Food Safety Compliance

### Professional Philosophy
I believe in leading by example, fostering team collaboration, and maintaining operational consistency to deliver exceptional guest experiences. My focus is on optimizing workflows and supporting staff development to meet the dynamic demands of high-volume hospitality settings.

Feel free to explore my projects and contributions related to service quality improvement and team training initiatives.
